scope: Audit and repair original-human data admission, per-intent treatment and preparation. No full acoustic fit, synthetic injection, deployment, physical actions or installed-artifact replacement.
hypothesis: Per-command/speaker/source coverage, correct supervision, leakage guards and matched preprocessing make a future human-only comparison interpretable; accuracy improvement must be measured, not inferred from this audit.
prior_test_exposure: The existing targeted trainer repeatedly scores test; prior session also tuned WEATHER/ALARM/TIMER thresholds against test outcomes. Published test and holdout are regression only.
normalization: Refit on exactly admitted human train; frozen global baseline, optional CMVN ablation separately versioned and deployment-matched.
quality_claim_gate: New blind human speakers/sessions, predeclared precision/recall/FAR targets, fixed catalog/preprocessing, development-only model selection, calibration-only policy fitting, then immutable selection-before-test receipt.
recording_review: At least two independent reviewers for disputed transcripts/slots/boundaries; retain disagreements and evidence hashes; do not convert uncertainty to UNKNOWN.
fitting_status: Not run. A single explicitly labelled CPU optimizer plumbing smoke may run, with no accuracy or model promotion claim.

future_comparison.sampling: intent -> typed command -> source -> speaker -> recording with true-human negative strata
future_comparison.selection: macro-intent and macro-speaker complete-command recall under fixed precision/FAR constraints; no mixed-phase bonus
future_comparison.blocked_until: Missing original-human command/calibration cells and annotation review are addressed
